note: Offline gates of the round-6 brake rules (branch m6-brake): the early brake (configs/obstacles/early_brake.json v1) and motor assist version 4 (configs/pilot/motor_assist.json; v3 kept). Scored by haltere.obstacles.early_brake_gates (harness, replays, windows, score). Frozen and committed before any harness, replay or window run of these gates. Development evidence: the logs under logs.development (read while the rules were designed; straw-brain08-06 is the round-5 integration's ceiling-cut case) and the harness sets dev17/g23/h41/h67 and pt17/pt41 (seeds 17, 23, 41, 67). Held-out: the fresh harness sets below (seed 83, parameter values used by no earlier set), hill courses 6500-6511, and the logs under logs.held_out, which no replay of these rules touched before the freeze. None of it is flight evidence.
baseline: the m5 tree (git archive m5, bc7c71c): the flight stack of round 5 without the new rules

replays.note: stack: --stack on --near-on-path --throttle-column command_thr with descent view v3 (contact support on) and stale evidence v2, the round-5 flight stack; the baseline tree's configs/pilot/motor_assist.json is version 3

surrogate.loop: haltere.train.brake_gates.replay_window: IdentifiedSim (measured original drone, no randomisation), 3-tick command delay, quadratic drag 0.0075, from the logged state; the request and the yaw stick per logged row from a replay (rows the replay skipped keep the log); a brain warmed on its recorded inputs for warm_s

windows.what: the hairpin approach to 0.05 s before the wall impact (motor assist v3 gates window)

harness.gated_note: the surrogate gates score fast-brain-11-b-cw13 (the brain flown in rounds 4b and 5) and fast-brain-10b; brain-09b is reported: in development its braking sank it to the floor at pass-through arches (pt41, live-like samples: 3 of 8 with the early brake, 2 with motor assist v3 and with the early brake and v4, none without either)

hairpin_gate.note: REPORT: the gate-style samples (below_fraction 0.5, ttc_lower = ttc)

harness.note: motor_assist_eval.run_scenarios (IdentifiedSim, 10% randomisation, synthetic HUD marker, 3-tick delay, synthetic wall looming at 18 Hz received 0.085 s later; live_wall_samples: below_fraction None and no lower-surface TTC, as the recorded Minus Two wall samples) and descent_rehearsal.run_batch for hills; base = the deployed m5 stack (haltere.train.deployed_pilot with the stale-evidence rule)

identity.threshold: every command array (cvx, cvy, cvz, yaw_cmd, state, cap, climb, descent_scale) bit-identical on every log

D1_hairpin_warning.threshold: DEVELOPMENT, open loop: with the early brake the governor's cap first binds the request >= 1.0 s before the impact (within the last 3 s)

D2_hairpin_cut.threshold: DEVELOPMENT, open loop: with the early brake and motor assist v4 the final continuous cut of >= 1 m/s below the round-5 stack's request starts >= 1.0 s before the impact

D3_hairpin_window.threshold: DEVELOPMENT, surrogate from the logged state: speed 0.05 s before the logged impact with the early brake and assist v4 <= the round-5 stack's - 1.5 m/s

D4_first_arch.threshold: DEVELOPMENT, open loop: before the first arch (x < 19 m) no tick without a wall-ahead condition (and none in the preceding 0.3 s) where the assisted request lies below min(the pilot's own, 2.5 m/s) - 0.01

D5_ceiling_share.threshold: DEVELOPMENT, open loop: 37.49-38.77 s, no tick in state cue with an assist climb where the pilot's own vertical request under motor assist v4 lies more than 0.05 m/s below the unassisted stack's

H1_hairpin.threshold: HELD OUT (16 fresh hairpins, live-like samples), per gated brain, the early brake with assist v4 against the round-5 stack without an assist: clean >= base + 6; walls <= floor(25% of base); floor, ceiling <= base + 1; and walls <= assist v3's + 4

H2_passthrough.threshold: HELD OUT (12 fresh pass-through arches, live-like samples), per gated brain, the early brake alone and with assist v4: finished >= base; contacts <= base; the lowest speed from 1.5 s before to 0.5 s after the arch pass >= 0.75 m/s in every scenario and >= 1.5 m/s median

H3_hill.threshold: HELD OUT (hill courses 6500-6511), per gated brain, early brake + assist v4 against the base: finishes >= base; crashes <= base; chatter <= 1.15 x; paired finish time <= +2%; terrain contacts <= base + 1; high passes <= base + 2

H4_replays.crawl_threshold: HELD OUT brain logs, open loop: seconds with the ring ahead (states cue, below, below_weak, above) where the request is below 2 m/s while the round-5 stack asks >= 3 m/s: <= 0.1 s per log, early brake alone and with assist v4
H4_replays.eb_quiet_threshold: HELD OUT Straw Bale and Pine Valley brain laps: the early brake removes <= 1.5% of the round-5 stack's horizontal request travel per lap
H4_replays.floor_threshold: ALL brain logs: no tick without a wall-ahead condition (and none in the preceding 0.3 s) where assist v4's request lies below min(own, 2.5) - 0.01
H4_replays.assist_quiet_threshold: HELD OUT Straw Bale and Pine Valley brain laps: early brake + assist v4 remove <= 3% of the request travel per lap (assist v3's quiet bound)

H5_ceiling_share.threshold: HELD OUT brain logs: seconds in state cue with an assist climb where the pilot's own vertical request under assist v4 lies > 0.05 m/s below the unassisted stack's: <= 0.1 s per log

reported_not_gated: hairpin results with the gate-style samples; assist v3 beside every surrogate gate; per-log replay changes (every log, development marked); the fast PD's minus-fast6-r5-01 exit (analysis in docs/early_brake.md)
